resources.string: Use this phone as a second monitor for your Linux desktop.
Tandem by Saharsh Baiju · github.com/saharshbaiju/tandem · GPL-3.0
On your computer run tandem, choose Start Tandem, then scan the QR code shown in the terminal.
Make sure Tandem is running on your computer.
Tap, drag, scroll and pinch on the screen. Your computer\'s mouse pointer stays put.
Shown under the QR code in tandem
Enter the computer\'s IP address (e.g. 192.168.42.129) and the pairing code shown in tandem.
This QR code is from an older version without encryption. Update Tandem on the computer (re-run the install command) and scan the new QR code.
This computer was paired with an older version. Scan its QR code again (or enter its pairing code).
A link wants this phone to connect to %1$s. Only continue if this is your computer: it will see your touches.
